1.title: Trump Is Promoting ‘Freedom Fuel’ for $3.47 a Gallon. Who’s Behind It?
1.summary: The president has praised a network of 25 recently rebranded gas stations in the Philadelphia region that have been selling gas for considerably less than the national average.

2.title: ICE Deports Immigrant Who Was Pardoned for Sex Abuse Conviction
2.summary: Minnesota state officials had granted a pardon to Tou Lue Vang, a Hmong man, drawing criticism that Democratic leaders were thwarting efforts to expel criminals.

3.title: Witnesses of ICE Killing in Houston Dispute the Official Account
3.summary: The agency said a Mexican immigrant driving a van tried to ram agents before they shot him dead. A lawyer for three passengers said that was untrue.

4.title: Can Hungarian Holocaust Survivors Find Justice in the U.S.?
4.summary: For more than a decade, a group of survivors have fought a legal battle to get American courts to hear their suit against Hungary’s national railroad over its role in the atrocities.

5.title: At Least 12 People Die in Southern Spain Wildfire
5.summary: The blaze in Andalusia, one of the deadliest on record in the country, also left more than 20 people missing. Many of the victims were foreign tourists, the Spanish authorities said.

6.title: Superb Sinner ends Djokovic's latest bid for history
6.summary: Jannik Sinner produces a devastating display to end Novak Djokovic's latest bid for history and set up a Wimbledon final against Alexander Zverev.
